supporting_passages: This one was inspired by our day exploring Cinque Terre, Italy.
We stayed at a beautiful campsite while we were visiting the area called Camping Acqua Dolce in the town of Levanto
Our favorite part of the whole hike was actually the first portion we did from Levanto to the next town over Monterosso because it was really peaceful and there was hardly anyone on the trail.
We did do the Cinque Terre day card so that we could hike from Monterosso to Vernazza, which is the only trail you have to pay for.
I'd also highly recommend taking one of the ferries, especially when going to visit Riomaggiore
The Cinque Terre day pass lets you ride as many trains as you want, which was helpful for as as we navigated between towns, but didn't cover our boat trip.
We were there in mid-April though which made the crowds manageable and the weather not too hot.
